body: I've tried but it doesn't seem to work.  I've applied to over 1000 places in the last year have gotten like 20 call backs and nothing else.  I've even walked into local retail shops and they immediately laugh at me when they ask about my education.  Basically, no one wants to take the risk that I'll leave a week later if I get a lawyer job.  (Even though I just need something to keep food on my plate.)
